# S6: Finale, the date returns: Victory

**Model:** Opus 5.5, high. **Paste to start:** `Read CLAUDE.md, then docs/build/STATUS.md and docs/build/scenes/S6.md, and do S6. Stop for my review at the key frames, and again at the end.`
**Spec:** `sed -n 406,423p PROTEST_VIZ_SPEC.md` (S6). Shared rules: [README.md](README.md).

## Purpose
The payoff: the larger map roaches walk in and re-form the finale date on the skeleton (the S4 engine, faster converge), then "Victory" and the resignation line.

## Allowed data keys
- `meta.finale.{date, headline, line, source_ids}` ("25/07/2026", "Victory", the line verbatim with `*`).
- `timeline.nodes[victory].facts[]` (showable only) if the scene needs supporting facts (Vali, 2026-11-12: S6 may draw on them).
- `byId.source` for the `*`.

## Files it owns
- `src/scenes/s06-finale.js` (+ CSS).

## Must not touch
The common list in README; `src/scenes/s04-date.js` (import S4's engine if S4b exported it; otherwise ask for a shared helper rather than copying).

## Contracts it consumes
- Finale stage (`block main`, `stage finale`): **S6 p 0 = S5 p 1**, handed over in place.
- `skeleton()` / `brackets()` (Public Sans Black), `roach()`; the `.stage-dramatic` primitive in tokens (ink: red stage, black roaches, white text).
- S6 p 1 then scrolls away over 100vh as S6.5 (a reading section) comes up.

## Key frames
| p | Expected picture | Storyboard |
|---|---|---|
| S6 0 | Handover from S5 p 1, no jump. | none |
| S6 0.85 | Dramatic stage; the finale date re-formed by the larger map roaches, brackets; "Victory" in display type beneath; `finale.line` verbatim with `*`; first roaches peel away downward. | `ink-S6.png` |

## Done when
- The line is exactly the data text with a working `*` (it has `source_ids`, so no "unsourced" note is needed).
- Spec timings: converge 0–0.30, hold 0.30–0.55, "Victory" 0.55–0.75, line 0.75–1 with the peel-away.
- QA both ways, compare sheets with down≠up 0%, `qa-shell` all PASS.

- **"Victory" appears only here** (2026-11-12). No Victory node in S5.
- Review 1 left open whether "Victory" under the date repeats the old standalone Victory frame. Review 2 removed that frame, so it's probably settled. Confirm with Vali at the key-frame gate.
